correctness.rationale: Zak Parseval gives the exact scalar frame symbol; Poisson summation gives a closed rational Zak transform. The frequency minimum is exactly at one half by AM–GM applied to the only frequency-dependent positive term. A strictly increasing and convex rational map of sine-square and its trigonometric two-shift sum yield the claimed sharp global spatial minimum with exhibited equality. The derivative, normalization, boundaries, and quadratic expansion are checked algebraically; CHECK.py supplies independent finite consistency tests, not a proof.
